papers.title: Bayesian Optimization with Shape Constraints
papers.abstract: In typical applications of Bayesian optimization, minimal assumptions are made about the objective function being optimized. This is true even when researchers have prior information about the shape of the function with respect to one or more argument. We make the case that shape constraints are often appropriate in at least two important application areas of Bayesian optimization: (1) hyperparameter tuning of machine learning algorithms and (2) decision analysis with utility functions. We describe a methodology for incorporating a variety of shape constraints within the usual Bayesian optimization framework and present positive results from simple applications which suggest that Bayesian optimization with shape constraints is a promising topic for further research.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法将形状约束融入贝叶斯优化框架，可迁移至生物力学设计中的约束优化问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not apply to biomechanical implant design, lacks explicit uncertainty quantification beyond standard GP, and uses only simple numerical benchmarks without real engineering FEA validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化通常不对目标函数形状做假设，但实际中常存在形状先验信息。
summary_zh.method: 提出将多种形状约束融入高斯过程代理模型的贝叶斯优化框架。
summary_zh.result: 简单应用表明带形状约束的贝叶斯优化能提升优化效率与结果合理性。
summary_zh.validation: 在超参数调优和决策分析的标准测试问题上进行仿真验证。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization typically makes minimal assumptions about the objective, yet prior shape knowledge is often available in practice.
summary_en.method: A methodology is proposed to incorporate various shape constraints into the Gaussian process surrogate within the Bayesian optimization framework.
summary_en.result: Simple applications demonstrate that incorporating shape constraints can improve optimization efficiency and solution feasibility.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard benchmark problems from hyperparameter tuning and decision analysis.

papers.title: A comparison on metallurgical behaviors of 316L stainless steel by selective laser melting and laser cladding deposition
papers.first_author_affiliation: Wuhan National Laboratory for Optoelectronics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan 430074, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Xiaoyan Zeng
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Wuhan National Laboratory for Optoelectronics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan 430074, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及316L不锈钢的激光增材制造冶金行为，但未涉及任何生物医学植入物、应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合内容，与用户方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on metallurgical comparisons between selective laser melting and laser cladding of 316L stainless steel, with no biomedical context, implant design, stress shielding analysis, or mechanical testing related to hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较选区激光熔化和激光熔覆沉积316L不锈钢的冶金行为差异
summary_zh.method: 对两种工艺制备的样品进行微观组织和力学性能表征
summary_zh.result: 两种工艺得到的显微组织和力学性能存在显著差异
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试和微观表征进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To compare the metallurgical behaviors of 316L stainless steel fabricated by selective laser melting and laser cladding deposition.
summary_en.method: Microstructural characterization and mechanical testing were performed on samples produced by both processes.
summary_en.result: Significant differences in microstructure and mechanical properties were observed between the two additive manufacturing methods.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through metallographic analysis and mechanical tests.
